title: New Strategies of Genetic Study of Patients With Oculocutaneous Albinism
brief_summary: The oculocutaneous albinism is an autosomal recessive condition associated with mutations in 4 genes. In 20% of patients no mutation is identified. The optimization of genetic analysis methods and the search for new genes involved will help improve the diagnosis in these patients.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

-Oculocutaneous albinism (diagnosis validated by a clinician at the initial genetic consultation and did not show mutations of the TYR, OCA2, TYRP1, SLC45A2 genes)

Exclusion Criteria:

None
study_population: Patients having been examined during a genetic consultation, with Oculocutaneous Albinism
